description: Minimal runtime boundary required by the first production recursive @type path. Materialized executable return transport currently calls Types::runtime_type_predicate solely to ask whether a type is exclusively one exact tuple arity, forcing recursive descent through μ children. Replace that broad projection with one exact non-descending root-shape query owned by Types. It answers false for μX. :start | {integer, X} at the atom alternative and does not inspect tuple fields. Preserve every acyclic transport result and prove recursive @type backend materialization reaches the next intended gate without runtime predicate construction. No predicate-component graph, callsite/receive relation work, native runtime-test change, or transport re-entry layout change belongs here; defer those unless a concrete μ path reaches them.

title: Transport asks exact root tuple shape without descending
